description: This file defines the interface for managing a topology tree of ALE nodes, including creation, insertion, removal, traversal, and querying of nodes within the topology.

methods.name: get_ktree_node
methods.description: Returns the tree node associated with a given ALE node.

methods.name: get_ale_from_tree
methods.description: Retrieves the ALE node from a given tree node.

methods.name: map_get_next_ale_in_list
methods.description: Fetches the next ALE node from an array list of tree nodes.

methods.name: fetch_and_free_child_iter
methods.description: Fetches the next child ALE node from an iterator and frees the iterator.

methods.name: make_ale_orphaned
methods.description: Removes a node from the topology tree, making it orphaned.
